headline: A routine deal step: an Australian court signs off on CRML's already-announced European Lithium acquisition
reasoning: Source: Benzinga Newsdesk 12:34 UTC, a headline-only item: 'Critical Metals Announces Supreme Court Of Western Australia Approves Proposed Acquisition Of European Lithium'. It has no body text.
The acquisition is described as 'proposed', meaning announced earlier. Court approval of the scheme is a standard step before closing, and the terms were priced when the deal was first announced.
Pre-market: IEX shows no trades yet against Friday's 6.35 close. The stock's 30-day gaps run up to 29%, so a court step is noise beside its usual swings.
objections: No new terms; the court approval was expected and is a formality of the scheme.
